title: SG-3.4 · Frontend type-checks and entry point resolves
summary: Assembled game frontend passes tsc --noEmit, its entry point resolves to App, and an App render test covers it
description: Context: game/frontend holds the Vite React app (index.html -> src/main.tsx -> src/App.tsx). `npx tsc --noEmit` in game/frontend currently reports 3 errors, all in tests/layout.test.tsx (node:fs, node:path and process cannot be resolved because @types/node is not installed or configured). App render tests already exist in tests/app.test.tsx. Desired behavior: type-check is clean and the entry point is proven to resolve to App. Why: SG-3 playable frontend must be assembled and verifiable.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/frontend, when `npx tsc --noEmit` runs, then it exits 0 with no errors
Given index.html, when its module script src is read, then it is /src/main.tsx and that file exists and renders App into #root
Given the App component, when rendered in a test, then the intro screen shows and Begin reveals the game view

in_scope: new unit tests for entry and typecheck config
preserve: Existing App, layout, scene and story tests

technical_constraints: Keep React 18, Vite 5, Vitest 2, strict TypeScript
